text: Nanging Angkatan Laut Kerajaan isih luwih kuwat saka Angkatan Laut Jerman (“Kriegsmarine”) lan bisa wae ngremukake armada laut invasi ngendi wae sing dikirim liwat Selat Inggris.
text_en: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Nanging, sithik banget pra-prau Royal Navy iku manggon ana ning jalur sing cedhak panggon serangan amarga laksamana kuwi wedi yen prau kuwi bakal ndelep dening serangan udara kaya saka pasukan Jerman.
text_en: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Ayo diwiwiti saka penjelasan babagan rencanane Italia. Italia iku dhasare “adik lanang” saka Jerman lan Jepang.
text_en: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Iki duwe pasukan dharat sing luwih ringkih lan pasukan laut sing luwih ringkih, sanadyan dheweke lagi wae mbangun kapal anyar papat pas sadurunge wiwitane perang.
text_en: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Tujuan utamane Itali yaiku negara-negara ning Afrika. Kanggo nangkep negara-negara kasebut, Itali kudu nduweni landesan kanggo ngkuncurke prajurit, supaya para prajurit bisa nyebrang Laut Mediterania banjur nyerang Afrika.
text_en: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Kanggo iku, dheweke padha kudu nyingkirake pangkalan lan kapal Inggris ing Mesir. Saliyane tumindak iku kabeh, kapal perang Italia ora kudune nindakake apa-apa liyane.
text_en: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Saiki kanggo Jepang. Jepang iku negara kapuloan, padha kaya Inggris.
text_en: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Kapal selam yaiku kapal sing digawe kanggo lelungan ing jero banyu lan tetep ing kana kanggo sawetara wektu sing luwih dawa.
text_en: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Kapal silem digunakake ing Perang Donya I lan Perang Dunia II. Nalika semono alon-alon banget lan adohe let nembak sing winates.
text_en: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Nalika wiwitane perang biyasane dheweke plesir menyang pucuke segara, nanging nalika radar wis thukul lan saya luwih pener kapal selam kuwi dipeksa supaya mlebu menyang ngisor banyu supaya ora katon.
text_en: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Kapal selam Jerman kuwi diarani kapal-U. Wong-wong Jerman biyen dikenal pinter banget ngarahke lan nglakokake kapal selame.
text_en: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Amarga kasil karo kapal selam, sabubare perang Jerman ora dipercaya nyekel kapal selam.
text_en: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Yo! Raja Tutankhamun, kadang kala diarani “King Tut” utawa “Anak Raja”, iku salah sawijine raja Mesir Kuno sing isih dikenal ana mangsa moderen iki.
text_en: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Sing nggumunake, dheweke ora dianggep penting banget ing jaman kuno lan ora dicathet ing ameh kabeh daptar raja.
text_en: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Nanging, nalika nemokake kuburan iki taun 1922 gawe dheweke dadi selebriti. Nalika akeh kuburan kuna sing ditemokake dijarah, kuburan iki ditinggal tanpa diganggu.
text_en: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Ameh kabeh barang sing dikubur karo Tutankhamun wis diawetne kanthi becik, kalebu ewonan artefak sing digawe saka logam mulya lan watu sing arang.
text_en: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Panemon rodha sing nganggo ruji rodha bisa nggawe kreta bangsa Asiria luwih entheng, luwih cepet, lan luwih cawis kanggo mlayu luwih cepet tinimbang para prajurit lan kreta liyane.
text_en: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Panah saka busur silang bisa nembus klambi wesi saka prajurit saingan. Watara 1000 SM, wong-wong Assyria nepungake kavaleri sepisan.
text_en: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Kavaleri minangka bala sing tarung numpak jaran. Pelana isih durung ditemokake, saengga para kavaleri Asyur tarung ing jaran sing wuda.
text_en: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Kita kenal akeh politikus, ilmuwan, lan seniman. Mbok menawa wong sing paling misuwur saka budaya iki yaiku Homer, pujangga wuta legendaris, sing nyungsun rong karya gedhe sastra Yunani: Geguritan Iliad lan Odyssey.
text_en: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sophocles lan Aristophanes isih dadi penulis naskah sing misuwur lan critane dianggep dadi salah sijine asil literatur donya sing paling apik.
text_en: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Wong Yunani misuwur liyane yaiku matematikawan Pythagoras, sing paling misuwur kanthi teori sing misuwur babagan sesambungane ing sisih maju telu siku-siku.
text_en: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Ana werna-werna perkiraan sepira akehe wong-wong ngomong Hindi. Iki kira-kira antarane basa kaping pindho lan kaping papat sing paling umum dipocapake ing donya.
text_en: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Gunggung pamicara asli beda-beda gumantung saka tetembungan sing gegandhengan banget sing diitung.
text_en: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Kira-kira ana 340 yuta nganti 500 yuta manungsa sing nggunakake basa iki, 800 yuta manungsa mudheng basa iki.
text_en: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Basa Hindi lan Urdu kuwi suku ukarane persis nanging tulisane beda, ana omongan saben dina, wong sing omongan nganggo basa-basa kuwi bakal padha-padha mangerteni.
text_en: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Watara abad kaping 15 masehi, Estonia sisih lor iku sajroning pangaribawa budaya Jerman sing gedhe.
text_en: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Sawetara rahib Jerman pengin nyedhakake Pangerane karo para pribumi, mula bisa nemokake basa Estonia sing sejatine.
text_en: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Iki adhedhasar abjad Jerman lan siji karakter "Õ/õ" ditambahake.
text_en: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Seiring wektu kliwat, akeh tembung-tembung sing disilih saka Jerman gabung. Iki wiwitane saka pencerahan.
text_en: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Tradisine, pewaris tahta bakal langsung mlebu militer sakwise rampung sekolah.
text_en: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Nanging, Charles sekolah menyang kampus Trinity, Cambridge panggone dheweke sinau Antropologi lan Arkeologi, lan sabanjure Sejarah, ngasilake 2:2 (tingkat kelas kaping loro sing luwih cendhek).
text_en: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Charles minangka anggota kapisan Kulawarga Krajan Inggris sing oleh gelar sarjana.
text_en: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: Turki Eropa (Jalur sisih wetan Rumelia ning semenanjung Balkan) kalebu 3% negara.
text_en: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Wilayah Turki kuwi luwih dawa saka 1.600 kilometer (1,000 mi) lan ambane 800 km (500 mil), kanthi wujut kira-kira persagi.
text_en: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: Wilayah Turki, kalebu wadhuk, manggoni 783,562 kilometer persegi (300,948 mil persegi), ing ngendi 755,688 kilometer persegi (291,773 mil persegi) ana ing Asia Barat Dhaya lan 23,764 kilometer persegi (9,174 mil persegi) ing Eropa.
text_en: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Wilayah TUrki marakake iku negara paling amba kaping 37 ing donya, lan kira-kira ukurane padha kaya Prancis Metropolitn lan Inggris menawa digabung.
text_en: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Turki iku diubengi dening segara saka telung sisih: Segara Aegan ing kulon, Segara Ireng ing lor lan Segara Mediterania ing kidul.
text_en: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Luksemburg duwe sejarah dawa nanging tanggal kamardikane saka 1839.
text_en: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Bagian Belgium saiki iku bagian saka Luksemburg ing jaman biyen nanging dadi Belgia sawise Revolusi Belgia 1830-an.
text_en: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Luksemburg mesthi nyoba supaya tetep dadi negara sing netral nanging negara iki dipanggoni dening Jerman nalika Perang Donya I lan Perang Donya II.
text_en: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: Ing taun 1957, Luksemburg dadi anggota pangadeg organisasi sing saiki dikenal minangka Uni Eropa.
text_en: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Drukgyal Dzong iku benteng sing rusak lan biara Buddha ning ndhuwur Kabupaten Paro (ning Desa Phondey).
text_en: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Dikandhakake menawa ing 1649, Zhabdrug Ngawang Namgyel gawe benteng kanggo mengeti kemenangane nglawan pasukan wong Tibet-Mongol
text_en: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: Ing taun 1951, Kobongan nyebabake mung sawetara warisan Drukgyal Dzong isih ana, kaya gambar Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
text_en: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Sakwise kobongan, bentenge dilestarekake lan dilindhungi, tetep dadi salah siji atraksi Bhutan sing paling narik kawigaten.
text_en: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Nalika abad 18 Kamboja manggon ana tengah tanggane sing nduweni kakuwatan gedhe banget, Thailand lan Vietnam.
text_en: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Wong Thailand nyerang Kamboja kaping pirang-pirang ing abad kaping 18 lan ing taun 1772, dheweke ngrusak Phnom Phen.
text_en: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Nalika taun pungkasan abad 18 Vietnam uga njajah Kamboja.
text_en: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Wolung puluh persen wong Venezuela nganggur, lan umume sing nyambut gawe ing ekonomi ora resmi.
text_en: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Rong prelu saka wong Venezuela sing kerja ing bidhang jasa, meh saprapat sing kerja ing pabrik lan kalima ing tetanen.
text_en: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: industri sing paling penting ana ning Venezuela yaiku minyak, yaiku negara sing dodol, sanadyan mung sak persen sing makarya ana industri minyak iki.
text_en: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Ing wiwitan kamardikan bangsa, bangkat Botanic Gardens Singapura mbantu ngowah pulau dadi KuthaTaman tropis.
text_en: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: Ing taun 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, hibrida anggrek, dipilih dadi kembang nasional bangsa.
text_en: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Saben taun udakara wulan Oktober, meh 1,5 yuta herbivora ngumbara menyang dataran kidul, nyabrang Kali Mara, saka bukit sisih lor nganti udan.
text_en: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: Banjur bali ngalor saka kulon, pisan engkas ngliwati kali Mara, sakwise udan ing April.
text_en: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: Daerah Serengeti kalebu Taman Nasional Serengeti, Daerah Lindhung Ngorongoro lan Cadhangan Nasional Maasai Mara ning Kenya.
text_en: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Sinau nyiptakke media sing bisa padha-padha kaubung mbutuhake kakuwatan sing tradisional lan biyasa, uga piranti-piranti sing dikuwasani nalika melu kelas (gawe papan crita, swara lan ngowahi pideo, crita, lan liya-liyane.)
text_en: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Desain interaktif nuntut sampeyan kanggo mbiji maneh asumsi sampeyan babagan produksi media lan sinau kanggo mikir kanthi cara non-linear.
text_en: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Disain interaktif mbutuhake komponen- komponen saha proyek sing gumandheng siji lan liyane, nanging uga nggawe pangertene minangka sawijining entitas kapisah.
text_en: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: Kakurangane lensa kanggo nggedhekake yaiku karuwetan fokus lan jumlah elemen lensa sing dibutuhne kanggo ngentukne kisaran dawane fokus iku luwih gedhe tinimbang kanggo lensa utama.
text_en: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Iki dadi sethithik perkara nalika pabrik lensa entuk standar sing luwih dhuwur sajrone ngasilake lensa.
text_en: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Iki gawe lensa zoom bisa gawe gambar sing apik sing bisa dibandhingke karo lensa sing dawane fokus tetep.
text_en: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Kapitunan liya saka lensa zoom iku menawa celah maksimal (kecepatan) saka lensa iku biasane luwih rendah.
text_en: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Iki nggawe lensa zoom rega murah angel digunakake ing kahanan cahya sing sithik tanpa sumunar.
text_en: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Salah sawijining masalah sing paling umum nalika nyoba ngowahi film dadi bentuk DVD yaiku overscan.
text_en: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Akeh TV digawe kanthi cara kanggo nyenengake masarakat umum.
text_en: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Kanthi alesan kuwi, kabeh sing sampeyan deleng ana TV wis diowahi.
text_en: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Iki digawe kanggo mesthekake menawa gambar nutup kabeh layar. Iki diarani overscan.
text_en: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Sayange, nalika sampeyan nggawe DVD, watesan uga bakal dikethok, lan yen vidio kasebut duwe naskah guneman kliwat cedhak mangisor, ora bakal diketokake kanthi ganep.
text_en: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: Astana abad pertengahan tradisional wis awit suwe nginspirasi imajinasi, nyulap gambaran olahraga joust, jamuan lan kasatriyan jaman Arthur.
text_en: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Ngadek ing tengah-tengah reruntuhan sing umure ewon taun uga gampang kanggo nggawa pikiran menyang swara lan ambu paprangan sing wis suwe ilang, kanggo ameh krungu swara sikil jaran ing dalan watu lan kanggo ngambu rasa wedi sing munggah saka rong ing jero lemah.
text_en: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Nanging apa angen-angene dhewe didhasari dening kasunyatan? Pisanan kenapa astana iku dibangun? Kepriye astana kuwi dirancang lan dibangun?
text_en: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Khusus kanggo wektu iki, Kraton Kirby Muxloe minangka omah sing luwih kuwat bentenge tinimbang kraton sing sejatine.
text_en: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Cendhela-chendela kacane sing amba lan tembok sing tipis ora bakal bisa nahen serangan sing ditemtokake kanthi suwe,
text_en: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: Ing taun 1480an, nalika pembangunane diwiwiti dening Ndara Hastings, negarane lumayan tentrem lan pertahanane amung dibutuhne nglawan kelompok cilik begal.
text_en: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: Kwasa sing imbang iku sistem sing negara Eropa goleki kanggo njaga kedaulatan nasional saka kabeg negara Eropa.
text_en: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: Gagasane yaiku kabeh negara Eropa kudu ngusadani nyegah siji negara dadi kuwat banget, lan mula saka kuwi pamrentahan nasional asring ganti aliansine kanggo njaga kaseimbangan.
text_en: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: Perang Pangganten Spanyol menehi tandha perang pisanan sing masalah utamane yaiku timbang kakuwatan.
text_en: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Iki nandhani owah-owahan sing penting banget, amarga kakuwatan wong Eropa ora bakal nduweni alesan maneh kanggo perang sing dhasare agama. Mula, Perang Telung Puluh Taun iki bakal dadi perang sing keri dhewe sing dijenengi perang agama.
text_en: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: Kuil Artemis ing Ephasus dirusak ing 21 Juli, 356 SM ing sajroning tumindak pembakaran sing ditindakake dening Herostratus.
text_en: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Miturut crita, dedelan kasebut pancen terkenal kanthi beya pira wae. Wong efesus, sing nesu, ngumumake yen jeneng Herostratus ora tau dicathet.
text_en: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: Ahli sejarah Yunani Strabo banjur nyathet jenenge, sing kita kenal saiki. Candhi kuwi dirusak nalika Alexander Agung lair wengi kae.
text_en: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Alexander, minangka raja, nawarne kanggo mbayar mbangun kuil maneh, nanging tawarane ditolak. Banjur sakwise Alexander mati, kuile dibangun maneh ing 323 BCE.
text_en: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Mesthekake tanganmu anteng kambi isih nabuh kabeh calathu kanthi bener - uga coba driji-drijimu aja kakehan obah.
text_en: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: Kanthi cara iki, sampeyan bakal ora krasa kesel banget. Kudu dieling-eling yen sampeyan ora kudu nggunakake tenaga sing gedhe kanggo mijet kunci kuwi kaya mijet piano.
text_en: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Ing akordian, kanggo entuk volume tambahan, sampeyan nggunakake embusan kanthi luwih mlenet lan cepet.
text_en: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: Mistisisme yaiku nggayuh sesrawungan karo, identitas karo, utawa karumangsan kasunyatan sing dhuwur, ketuhanan, bebener rohani, utawa Tuhan.
text_en: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: Para panganut ngupaya pangalaman langsung, gruneking ati, utawa wawasan babagan kasunyatan/dewa utawa dewa-dewa.
text_en: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: Para pandherek nguyak cara-cara urip tertamtu, utawa latihan sing dikarepake kanggo ngrumat pengalaman-pengalaman.
text_en: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: Kapercayan klenik bisa dibedhakake saka bentuk liya saka kapercayan agama lan pangibadahan kanthi penekanane marang pengalaman dhewe langsung saka kahanan kesadharan sing mbedani, utamane karakter sing ayem, duwe wawasan, tentrem, malah uga nyenengake.
text_en: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: Sikhisme kuwi agama saka anak benua India. Asline kabentuk ana ing daerah Punjab ana abad 15 saka anane rasa ora seneng ing njero tradisi agama Hindu.
text_en: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: Sikh nganggep imane dheweke padha dadi agama sing kapisah saka agama Hindu sanajan dheweke padha ngakoni iku sumber-sumber lan tradhisi-tradhisi Hindu.
text_en: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: Para sikh ngarani agamane Gurmat, yaiku tembung Punjabi kanggo “dalane guru”. Guru iki asepek dhasar saka kabeh agama ing India nanging Sikhisme nganggep kuwi penting sing mbentuk inti saka kepercayaane sikh.
text_en: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: Agama iki diadegaké ing abad ka-15 dening Guru Nanak (1469-1539). Ing kana disusul ing sanga guru sabanjure.
text_en: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Nanging, ing Juni 1956, janji-janji Krushchev diuji nalika karusuhan ing Polandia, ing ngendi para buruh protes babagan kakurangan pangan lan sudane opah, malih dadi protes umum ngelawan komunisme.
text_en: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text_en: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text_en: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text_en: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text_en: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text_en: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text_en: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

text_en: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

text_en: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

text_en: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

text_en: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.

text_en: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.

text: Cacad Kakurangan Perhatosan "minangka sindrom neurologis sing telung gejala klasik kalebu impulsif, reribed, lan hiperaktif utawa tenaga sing luwih-luwih".
text_en: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text: Iki menawa dudu ora bisa sinau, iku reribed sinau; iku "mangaruhi 3 nganti 5 persen saka kabeh bocah, bisa uga ana 2 yuta bocah-bocah Amerika".
text_en: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text: Bocah kanthi ADD susah kanggo fokus marang perkara-perkara kaya tugas sekolah, nanging bocah kuwi bisa konsentrasi menyang perkara sing seneng dilakoni kaya dolanan game utawa nonton kartun kasenengane utawa nulis ukara tanpa tandha.
text_en: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

text: Bocah-bocah kasebut ndhoyong ngalami akeh masalah, amarga "nduwe tumindak pituna, gelut, lan nantang panguwasa" kanggo ngrangsang utek, amarga uteke ora bisa dirangsang dening cara biyasa.
text_en: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

text: ADD mangaruhi sambungan karo kanca-kanca liyane amarga bocah liya ora ngerti geneya dheweke tumindak kaya ngono utawa geneya dheweke ngeja kaya ngono apa utawa dheweke duwe tingkat kadiwasan sing beda.
text_en: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.

text: Bebarengan karo malihe kemampuan kanggo golek wawasan lan kanggo sinau kanthi cara kaya sing disebutake ing dhuwur rata-rata dhasar ing ngendi wawasan dipikolehi uga malih.
text_en: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.

text_en: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.

text: Intine, jaman Renaissance gawe owah-owahan sing penting kanggo cara sinau lan nyebarke ilmu.
text_en: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.

text: Ora kaya primata liyane, klompok hominid ora nggunakake tangane maneh kanggo obah utawa nahan barang sing abot utawa gandhulan ana ning wit-witan.
text_en: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.

text: Tangan lan sikil simpanse duwe ukuran lan dawa sing padha, sing nuduhake panggunaan tangan kanggo nahan bobot nalika mlaku nganggo ros-rosan driji.
text_en: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.

text: Tangan menungsa iku luwih cendhak tinimbang sikile, kanthi balung jenthik sing luwih lurus.
text_en: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.

text: Fosil balung tangan loro yuta taun tekan telung yuta taun ngatonake ewahing iki ing spesialisasi tangan iku saka daya penggerak dadi manipulasi.
text_en: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.

text_en: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.

text: Alesan utama fenomena iki minangka asil kondisi impen sadhar sing njembarake dawane wektu ing antarane kondisi REM.
text_en: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.

text_en: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.

text: Iki padha kesele kaya-kaya sampeyan nglilir saben rong puluh utawa telung puluh menit lan nonton TV.
text_en: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.

text: Asile gumantung saka asringe utek sampeyan ngimpi kanthi jelas saben wengi.
text_en: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.

text_en: The modern sport of fencing is played at many levels, from students learning at a university to professional and Olympic competition.

text_en: The sport is primarily played in a duel format, one fencer dueling another.

text_en: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.

text_en: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.

text_en: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.

text_en: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.

text: Iki wayahe wong lunga menyang panggon sing beda banget karo urip saben dinane supaya bisa leyeh-leyeh lan seneng-seneng.
text_en: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.

text_en: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.

text_en: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.

text_en: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.

text_en: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.

text_en: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.

text_en: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.

text_en: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.

text_en: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.

text_en: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

text_en: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.

text: Populasi yaiku kumpulan organisme saka spesies tartamtu sajerone wilayah geografis kang ditamtokake.
text_en: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

text: Nalika kabeh individu ing populasi iku identik gegayutan karo ciri fenotipe tartamtu dheweke dikenal kanthi aran monomorfik.
text_en: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

text: Nalika ana individu sing nuduhake sipat-sipat tartamtu mangka dianggep dadi polimorpik.
text_en: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

text_en: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

text: Sel iku unit utama saka sakabehing makhluk urip, lan kabeh organisme iku kasusun saka siji sel utawa luwih.
text_en: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

text: Sel iku dadi dhasar lan penting kanggo nyinaoni urip, satemene, nganthi sel asring diarani minangka “balok pembangun urip”.
text_en: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text: Sistem Saraf njaga homeostatis kanthi ngirim impulse saraf liwat sakabehane awak kanggo njaga ilining getih lancar kaya tanpa gangguan.
text_en: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text: Rangsangan saraf iki bisa disalurke kanthi cepet banget menyang awak sing bisa njaga awak saka anceman sing bisa nyerang awak.
text_en: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text: Tornado ngrusak papan sing cilik dibandhingake karo lesus ampuh liyane, nanging iku padha bisa ngrusak apa wae ing lintasane.
text_en: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.

text: Lesus kuwi nyabut oyote wit-witan, nyuwek papan saka gedhung, lan ngumbulake montor menyang langit. Rong persen lesus sing paling medeni bisa kedadeyan luwih saka telung jam.
text_en: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.

text: Badai monster iku duwe cepet nganti 480 kilometer/jam (133 meter/detik; 300 meter per jam).
text_en: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).

text: Manungsa wis gawe lan migunakake lensa kanggo nggedhekake kanggo ewon-ewon taun.
text_en: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.

text: Ananging, teleskop tenanan kang sepisan digawe ing Eropa ing pungkasan abad 16.
text_en: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.

text: Teleskop- teleskop iki nggunakake gabungan loro lensa kanggo gawe objek-objek sing adoh katon luwih cerak lan gedhe.
text_en: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.

text: Rasa serakah lan pengin menang dhewe iku bakal mesthi ana ning njero awake dhewe lan iki dadi sipat kanggo makarya bareng yaiku yen kita wis nduweni kabeh kauntungan gedhe isih ana akeh banget sing bisa jukuk kanthi cepet nalika nduweni rasa kepingin menang dhewe.
text_en: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly

text: Muga-muga akeh wong ngerteni manawa pilihan jangka dawa paling apik yaiku makarya kanthi bebarengan.
text_en: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.

text: Akeh wong ngimpi nalika manungsa bisa lelungan menyang bintang liyane lan njelajah ing jagad liyane, sawetara wong takon-takon menawa ing njaba kana sing percaya yen makluk asing utawa kauripan liya bisa urip ing planet liya.
text_en: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.

text: Nanging, yen iki nate dumadi mungkin ora bakal dumadi kanggo wektu sing suwe. Lintang-lintang sumebar temenan iku ana triliunan mil antarane bintang sing iku “tanggane”.
text_en: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

text: Mungkin sawijining dina, putu buyut sampeyan bakal ngadeg ing pucuking donya asing penasaran babagan leluhur kunane?
text_en: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?

text: Kewan digawe saka pirang-pirang sel. Dheweke mangan lan ngluluhake ing njero. Umume kewan bisa obah.
text_en: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.

text: Mung kewan sing nduweni utek (sanadyan ora kabeh kewan nduweni utek, ubur-ubur umpamane, ora nduweni utek).
text_en: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).

text: Kewan-kewan ditemokake ing saindeging bumi. Iku padha ngedhuk lemah, nglangi ing segara, lan mabur ing langit.
text_en: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.

text: Sel iku struktur sing paling cilik lan unit fungsional makhluk (barang) organisme.
text_en: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.

text: Sel asale saka tembung Latin cella sing tegese kamar cilik.
text_en: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.

text: Menawa sampeyan ngulati barang urip sangisore mikroskop, sampeyan bakal ndelok menawa dheweke digawe saka kothak-kothak utawa bal-bal cilik.
text_en: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.

text: Robert Hooke, pakar biologi saka Inggris, ndelok kothak-kothak cilik ing gabus nganggo mikroskop.
text_en: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.

text: Iku katon kaya kamar-kamar. Dheweke wong pisanan sing ngamatne sel mati.
text_en: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells

text: Unsur lan senyawa bisa pindah saka kahanan siji menyang liyane lan ora ewah.
text_en: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.

text: Nitrogen minangka gas isih nduweni sipat sing padha karo nitrogen encer. Kahanan encer luwih ringkes nanging molekul isih padha.
text_en: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.

text: Banyu iku tuladha liyane. Senyawa banyu kasusun saka loro atom hidrogen lan siji atom oksigen.
text_en: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

text: Struktur molekule kuwi tetep padha sanadyan wujute gas, cair, utawa padhet.
text_en: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

text: Sanadyan wujude bakal malih, nanging wujud kimiane bakal tetep padha.
text_en: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.

text: Wektu iku sawijing perkara kang ana sakubunge awake dhewe, lan ngaruh menyang apa wae sing awake dhewe lakoni, nanging uga angel dimangerteni.
text_en: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.

text: Wektu wis disinau dening para sarjana agama, filsafat, lan ilmiah saka ewunan taun.
text_en: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

text: Awake dhewe ngalami wektu minangka rentetan kadadean liwat saka mbesuk ngliwati saiki lan kala wingi.
text_en: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text: Wektu iku uga kepiye kita mbandhingake jangka wektu(suwene) kedadean.
text_en: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.

text: Sampeyan bisa nengeri dhewe lakune wektu kanthi ngulati pengulangan acara rutin. Acara rutin iku perkara sing kasadean maneh lan maneh kanthi teratur.
text_en: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.

text: Komputer saiki dienggo ngowahi poto lan video.
text_en: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.

text: Animasi canggih bisa digawe ing komputer, lan animasi kaya iki saya akeh digunakake ing televisi lan film.
text_en: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.

text: Musik asring kacathet nggunakake komputer sing modheren kanggo ngolah lan nyampur swara.
text_en: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.

text: Kanggo wektu sing suwe sasuwene abad kaping sangalas lan rongpuluh, iku dipercaya warga sepisan ing Selandia Baru iku wong-wong Maori, sing mburu manuk raseksa sing diarani moas.
text_en: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.

text: Ajaran iki banjur netepake ide manawa wong-wong Maori pindah saka Polinesia ing Great Fleet lan njupuk Selandia Baru saka Moriori, dadi masarakat tetanen.
text_en: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.

text: Nanging, bukti anyar nuduhake yen Moriori minangka pepanthan dharatan Maori sing pindah saka New Zealand menyang Kapuloan Chatham, ngembangake kabudayan sing khas lan tentrem.
text_en: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

text: Ana ing pulo Chatam uga ana suku liyane yaiku suku Maori sing ngalih saka Selandia Baru.
text_en: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.

text: Dheweke padha ngarani dheweke dhewe Moriori ana sawetara paprangan cilik lan ing pungkasane, Moriori musnah.
text_en: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out

text: Wong-wong sing wis melu kanggo sawetara dasawarsa ngewangi awake dhewe ngajeni kakuwatan lan semangate dhewe nalika ngukur angele lan uga gagale kanthi jujur.
text_en: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.

text: Nalika ngrungokake saben wong nuduhake crita pribadi, kulawarga, lan pakumpulan, kita entuk wawasan sing penting ing mangsa kepungkur lan sawetara kapribaden sing mangaruhi kabecikan utawa ala budaya pakumpulan.
text_en: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.

text: Nalika ngerti sarasilahe wong aja nganggep ngerti budayane, paling ora mbantu masarakat entuk pangerten ing pundi dheweke ana ing sarasilah pakumpulan.
text_en: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.

text: Nalika ngevaluasi kesuksesan lan dadi sadhar marang kegagalan, individu lan kabeh wong sing melu nemokake kanthi luwih jero nilai-nilai, misi, lan kekuatan pendhorong organisasi.
text_en: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.

text: Ing perkara iki, ngeling-eling prilaku wirausaha sing sadurunge lan asile bisa mbantu supaya manungsa bisa nrima owah-owahan anyar lan uga dalan anyar kanggo gereja lokal iki.
text_en: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

text: Crita sukses kaya mengkono nyuda rasa wedi marang perubahan, semono uga gawe kecenderungan positif tumrap perubahan ing mangsa ngarep.
text_en: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.

text: Cara mikire konvergen yaiku teknik ngrampungake masalah sing nggabungake gagasan utawa ranah sing beda-beda kanggo nemokake solusi.
text_en: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.

text: Sing perlu digatekake saka cara pikir iki yaiku cepete, logika lan katelitian, uga cara mriksa kasunyatan, nggunakake maneh teknik sing wis ana, kanthi nglumpukake informasi.
text_en: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

text: Faktor paling penting kanggo cara pikir iki yaiku: namung ana siji jawaban bener. Sampeyan mung mikir rong jawaban, bener utawa salah.
text_en: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.

text: Pikirane jinis iki gegayutan karo prosedur ilmu kawruh tartamtu utawa tata cara baku.
text_en: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

text: Wong sing nduweni cara pikir kaya ngene iki bisa mikir kanthi logis, bisa ngeling-eling pola, mecahke perkara lan nggarap ujian ilmiah.
text_en: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

text: Manungsa minangka titah paling trampil ing maca pikiran wong liya.
text_en: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.

text: Iku tegese kita bisa ngramal kanthi sukses kanggo apa sing wong liya rasakake, maksud, percaya, mangerteni utawa pengini.
text_en: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

text: Ing antarane ketrampilan iki, mangerteni karepe wong liya iku penting banget. Iku ndadekake awake dhewe bisa nerangake keambiguan sing bisa kadadean saka tumindak fisik.
text_en: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

text: Contone, yen sampeyan ndeleng wong ngrusak jendhela mobil, sampeyan bisa nganggep manawa dheweke nyoba nyolong mobil wong liya.
text_en: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.

text: Dheweke bakal kudu diadili kanthi beda menawa dheweke kunci mobile ilang lan mobile dheweke dhewe sing coba dileboni paksa.
text_en: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.

text: Pathokane MRI kuwi yaiku kadadean fisika sing diarani resonansi magnet nuklir (NMR), sing ditemokake taun 1930 dening Felix Bloch (sing nyambut gawe ana ing Universitas Stanford) lan Edward Purcell (saka Universitas Harvard).
text_en: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text: Ana resonansi iki, medan magnet lan gelombang radio nyebabke atom-atom ngirimke sinyal radio sing cilik banget.
text_en: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

text: Ing taun 1970, Raymond Damadian, dhokter pangobatan lan ahli elmu panliti, nemokake dhasar kanggo nggunakake pepethan resonansi maknit minangka alat kanggo diagnosa pangobatan.
text_en: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

text: Patang sasi sabanjure hak paten diwenehake, sing dadi paten kapisan kanggo perkara bidang MRI ana donya.
text_en: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

text: Taun 1977, Dr. Damadian ngrampungke bangunan mesin pindai MRI “kabeh-awak”, sing dijenengi “Indomitable”.
text_en: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.

text: Komunikasi asinkron nyengkutung wektu kanggo refleksi lan reaksi marang wong liya.
text_en: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

text: Iki ngidinake para siswa mampu kanggo kerja kanthi cepete dheweke dhewe padha lan ngatur cepete informasi pasinaon.
text_en: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.

text: Sakliyane kuwi, ana wayah larangan sing luwih cepet kanthi anane kasempatan jam kerja sing luwih bisa diowah-owahi. (Bremer, 1998)
text_en: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)

text: Panganggone Internet lan Jaringan Luas Donya menehi kemungkinan pembelajar kanggo duwe akses marang informasi saben wektu.
text_en: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.

text: Siswa-siswa uga bisa nglumpukke pitakonan marang guru sak wayah-wayah lan ngarepake tanggepan kanthi cepet, tinimbang ngenteni nganti kelas langsung.
text_en: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.

text: Cara nyedhaki nalika wis moderen, kanggo nyinau nawakke kabebasan saka sing mutlak. Ora ana cara sing apik kanggo sinau.
text_en: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.

text: Saktemene, ora ana perkara apik siji thk sing bisa disinau. SInau kelakon ing pengalaman antarane wong sinau lan wawasan sing disuguhake.
text_en: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.

text: Pangalaman kita saiki karo kabeh presentasi babagan nggawe-dhewe lan katrangan, acara TV adhedhasar piwulang nggambarake bab iki.
text_en: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

text: Akeh banget saka awake dhewe sing nonton acara TV sing nuduhake awake dhewe proses utawa pengalaman ing ngendi awake dhewe ora bakal ngeloni utawa nganggo wawasan kasebut.
text_en: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.

text: Awake dhewe ora bakal mbongkar mobil, mbangun pancuran ing latar mburi omahe dhewe, lunga menyang Peru kanggo mariksa jugrugan kuno, utawa model ulang omahe tangga.
text_en: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.

text: Awit saka sambungan kabel serat optik ngisor laut menyang Eropa lan broadband satelit, Greenland bisa nyambung apik kanthi 93% pedunung sing duwe akses internet.
text_en: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.

text: Hotel utawa lusmen sampeyan (yen sampeyan manggon ing omah tamu utawa omah pribadi) bakal duwe wifi utawa PC sing ana sambungan internet, lan kabeh panggonan duwe kafe internet utawa lokasi kanthi wifi umum.
text_en: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.

text: Kaya sing diumumke ning ndhuwur, sanadyan ukara “Eskimo” tetep ditrima ana ning Amerika Serikat, nanging tetep dianggep ngremehke dening akeh woong Arktik dudu-Amerika Serikat, utamane ning Kanada.
text_en: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text: Sanajan sampeyan bisa ngrungokake tembung sing digunakake dening Pribumi Greenland, panggunaan kasebut kudu diluputake saka wong asing.
text_en: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.

text: Pribumi Greenland nyebut awake dhewe Inuit ing Kanada lan Kalaalleq (jamak Kalaallit), yaiku wong Greenlander, ing Greenland.
text_en: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text: Kejahatan, lan niatan ala marang wong asing umume, saktenane ora diweruhi ing Greenland. Semono uga ing kutha, ora ana “wilayah bahaya.”
text_en: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

text: Cuaca adhem iku mungkin siji-sijine bebaya nyata sing ora siap bakal diadhepi.
text_en: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

text: Menawa sampeyan ngunjungi Greenland sasuwene mangsa adhem (eling menawa luwih adoh sampeyan menyang lor, iki bakal dadi sansaya adhem), penting kanggo nggawa klambi anget sacukupe.
text_en: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text: Dina-dina sing suwe banget ing mangsa panas bisa njalari perkara-perkara turu sing cukup lan gegayutan perkara kasarasan.
text_en: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.

text: Nalika mangsa ketiga, ati-ati marang nyamuk Nordik. Sanadyan nyamuk-nyamuk iki ora nularke penyakit, nanging nyamuk iki ngganggu banget.
text_en: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text: Nalika ekonomi San Fransisko dihubungke marang iki dadi daya tarik pariwisata kelas donya, ekonomine maneka-warna.
text_en: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text: Bidhang kerja paling gedhe yaiku layanan ahli, pamrentah, keuangan, dedagangan, lan pariwisata.
text_en: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text: Gegambaran asring kawujud musik, film, sastra lan adat kang misuwur mbantu ndadekake kutha lan landmark kasebut dikenal ing saindenging jagad.
text_en: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text: San Fransisko wis kasil ngembangke sarana turis sing gedhe kanthi akeh banget hotel, restoran, lan fasilitas kanggo rapat sing apik banget.
text_en: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text: San Francisco uga minangka salah sawijining papan sing paling apik ing negara kasebut kanggo masakan Asia liyane: Korea, Thai, India lan Jepang.
text_en: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: Plesiran menyang Donya Walt Disney kuwi dadi jiarah utama kanggo akeh kaluwarga ana ning Amerika.
text_en: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: Kunjungan "khas" iki kalebu mabur menyang Bendara Internasional Orlando, njupuk bis menyang lusmen Disney ing dhaerah kasebut, ngentekake sajrone seminggu tanpa ninggalake piranti babagan Disney, banjur mulih.
text_en: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: Ana akeh macem pilihan sing ora terbatas, nanging iki isih bisa diarani nalika uwong umume ngomong babagan "arep menyang ing Disney World".
text_en: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: Akeh tiket sing payu kanthi cara onlen liwat situs web lelang kayata eBay utawa Craigslist separo dienggo tiket taman-hopper pirang-pirang dina.
text_en: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: Sanajan iki minangka kamempengan sing umum, dilarang dening Disney: tiket ora bisa ditransfer.
text_en: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: Sembarang perkemahan ing ngisor pinggir Ngarai Gedhe butuh ijin daerah njero.
text_en: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: Idin sing diwenehke ana wateane kanggo nglindhungi jurang iki, lan bakla kasedhiyan wiwit sasi ngarep, patang sasi sadurunge wiwitan sasi iki.
text_en: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: Mula, idin pedhaleman kanggo tanggal wiwitan kapan wae ing Mei dadi kasadhiya ing 1 Jan.
text_en: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: Ruang kanggo wewengkon sing paling misuwur, kayata Lapang Kemah Malekat Cahya, ing jejere Pangingon Phantom, umume diisi dening panyuwunan sing ditampa ing tanggal kapisan dibukak kanggo leladen.
text_en: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: Ana saperangan ijin sing diwatesi kanggo panjalukan teka langsung kasedhiya kanthi sistem teka pisanan, dilayani pisanan.
text_en: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: Mlebu Afrika Kidul numpak mobil minangka cara sing sangar kanggo ndeleng kabeh kaendahan derah uga kanggo nekani papan-papan ing njaba jalur misata sing biyasa.
text_en: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: Iki bisa dilakoni ing mobil biasa kanthi perencanaan sing ngati-ati nanging 4x4 iku disaranake banget lan akeh panggonan sing amung bisa diliwati nganggo basis roda dhuwur 4x4.
text_en: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: Prelu dieling nalika nganggit bilih sanajan Afrika Kidul ajeg, ora kabeh negara minangka tanggan.
text_en: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: Sarat lan beya visa beda-beda saka siji negara menyang negara liya lan dipangaruhi negara sing sampeyan tekani
text_en: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: Negara-negara uga nduweni aturan ukum sing khas sing mbutuhake piranti penting apa wae sing kudu ana ning njero montor.
text_en: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Victoria Falls iku kuta ing bagean kulon Zimbabwe, ngliwati wates saka Livingstone, Zambia, lan cedhak Botswana.
text_en: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: Kutha kasebut langsung ana ing jejere grojogan, lan iku dadi daya tarik utama, nanging tujuan turis sing populer iki nawakake petualang lan pelancong loro-lorone kesempatan sing akeh kanggo nginep luwih suwe.
text_en: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: Ing mangsa udan (November tekan Maret), akehe banyu bakal luwih gedhe lan grojogane bakal luwih dramatis.
text_en: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: Sampeyan mesthi teles menawa sampeyan nyebrang jembatan utawa mlaku sadawane dalan cilik menggok cerak Grojogan.
text_en: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: Ing sisih liya, kapinujon amarga isi banyu dhuwur banget mula yen sampeyan ndeleng Banyu terjun sing nyata bakal katon digedhahake—dening kabeh banyu!
text_en: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: Makam Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 menawa kuburan paling misuwur ing Lembah, panggon panemuan Howard Carter ing taun 1922 babagan penguburan raja enom sing meh wutuh.
text_en: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: Nanging dibandhingake karo makam-makam ningrat liyane, makam Tutankhamun ora patut ditekani, amarga luwih cilik lan rerenggan sing ora sepirane.
text_en: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Sapa wae sing kepingin ndeleng bukti-bukti saka mumi sing rusak nalika nyoba mindhahke pethi kuwi bakal kuciwa amarga mung sirah lan pundhak sing katon.
text_en: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: Kasugihan kuburan sing luwar biyasa kasebut ora ana maneh, nanging wis dipindhah menyang Musium Mesir ing Kairo.
text_en: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: Wong mara kanthi wektu sing kewatesan luwih becik ngentekake wektune ing panggonan liyane.
text_en: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phnom Krom, 12 km kidul kulon Siem Reap. Candi puncak bukit iki dibangun ing pungkasan abad kaping 9, nalika pamarentahan Raja Yasovarman.
text_en: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: Swasana kang peteng saka candhi lan pemandangan menyang wadhuk Tonle Sap agawe munggah bukite sepadan.
text_en: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: Kesah menyang panggonan kuwi bisa dicampur kanthi gampang nggunakake prau menyang tlaga.
text_en: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: Kertu Liwat Angkor kuwi dibutuhke kanggo mlebu menyang candhi mula aja lali nggawa kertu paspormu yennuju menyang Tonle Sap.
text_en: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Yerusalem kuwi ibukota lan kutha sing paling gedhe ning Israel, sanadyan akeh banget negara lan uga PBB ora ngaoni kutha iki dadi ibukota Israel.
text_en: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: Kutha kuno ing Bukit Yudea duwe sejarah sing narik kawigaten rentang ewunan taun.
text_en: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: Kutha kasebut iku suci kanggo telu agama monoteis - Yahudi, Kristen, lan Islam, lan minangka pusat spiritual, agama lan budhaya.
text_en: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Amarga kapentingan agama ana ning kutha, lan utamane akeh panggonan saka daerah Kutha Lawas, Yerusalem kuwi salah sawijine tujuan utama turis ana ning Israel.
text_en: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Jerusalem duwe akeh panggonan bersejarah, arkeologis lan budaya, kanthi pusat blanja sing werna-werni lan rame, cafe, lan restoran.
text_en: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: Ékuador menehi wewaton kanggo warga Kuba menawa nampa layang undhangan sadurunge mlebu Ékuador liwat bandara internasional utawa titik mlebu.
text_en: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: Layang iki kudu dilegalake dening Kementrian Luar Negeri Ekuador, lan nyaguhi marang syarat tartamtu.
text_en: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Persyaratan iki dirancang kanggo nyawisake sawijining aliran migrasi sing tumata antarane keloro negara.
text_en: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: Warga Kuba sing nyekel kertu ijo Amerika kudu marani Konsulat Ekuador supaya entuk pengecualian marang sarat iki.
text_en: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: Paspormu kudu sah kurang luwih 6 sasi sak njabane tanggal plesiranmu. Tiket kanggo sak ubengan/ plesir sabubare uga dibutuhke kanggo mbuktekake sepira suwene sampeyan bakal nginep.
text_en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Wisata luwih murah kanggo grup sing luwih gedhe, yen sampeyan mung ijen utawa karo kanca siji, coba golek wong liya lan gawe klompok papat nganti enem wong kanggo tarip sing luwih apik saben wong.
text_en: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Nanging, iki ora kudu dadi perhatianmu temenan, amarga para plancong asring dirubung kanggo ngisi mobil.
text_en: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: Iki kayane luwih kaya cara kanggo ngapusi wong-wong kanggo percaya menawa dheweke kudu mbayar luwih.
text_en: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Munggul ning ndhuwur pucuk sisih lor Machu Picchu yaiku gunung sing ndronjong, asring dadi latar mburi foto sing rumuntuh.
text_en: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: Katone rada medeni saka ngisor, lan munggah gunung kuwi bakal angel lan dhuwur banget, nanging wong sing paling sehat kudune bisa munggah 45 menit tekan ndhuwur.
text_en: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Watu pijekan dideleh sadawane dalan kuwi, lan ana panggonan sing luwih curam dipasangi kabel baja kanggo nguwatke cekelane.
text_en: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Sing ngandika, ngarepake kentekan ambegan, lan ati-ati ing bagean sing luwih njuleg, utamane nalika udan, amarga bisa mbebayani kanthi cepet.
text_en: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: Ana guwa sing cilik banget cedhak pucuke sing kudu diliwati, rada cendhek lan rada nyepit.
text_en: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Ndelok panggonan lan alam liar Galapagos iku paling apik nganggo prau, kaya sing dilakoni Charles Darwin ing 1835.
text_en: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Luwih saka 60 kapal besiar ngebaki laut Galapagos - wiwit saka ukuran 8 nganti 100 panumpang.
text_en: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: Akeh wong sing wis mesen kursi sadurunge mangkat rono (amarga akeh prau sing biyasane wis kebak nalika mangsane wis rame).
text_en: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Mesthekna agen sing ing ngendi sampeyan pesen iku ahline Galapagos kanthi wawasan sing apik babagan pirang-pirang macem kapal.
text_en: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Iki bakal njamin menawa minat lan/utawa alangan tartamtu sampeyan cocok karo kapal sing paling pas kanggo kuwi kabeh.
text_en: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Sadurunge wong Spanyol tekan nalika abad 16, Chili daerah Lor dipimpin dening aturan Suku Inca lan suku pribumi Araucanian (Mapuche) manggon ana ning Chili daerah kidul lan tengah.
text_en: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: Suku Mapuche uga dadi suku pribumi Amerika keri dhewe, sing ora kudu nganggo aturan nganggo basa Spanyol nganti sabubare kamardikan Chili.
text_en: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Sanajan Chili ngumumake kamardikan ing 1810 (ing tengah perang Napoleon sing ninggalake Spanyol tanpa sawijining pamerentah pusat sing berfungsi kanggo sawetara taun), kemenangan sing nemtokake marang Spanyol iku ora kagayuh nganti 1818.
text_en: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: Republik Dominika (Basa Spanyol; Republica Dominicana) yaiku negara ing wilayah Karibia sing manggon ana separo daerah wetanan saka pulo Hispaniola, sing diandum karo Haiti
text_en: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Ora mung pasir putih lan sesawangan gunung, negara iki uga omahe kutha Eropa sing paling tuwa ning Amerika, saiki dadi bageyane Santo Domingo.
text_en: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: Wiwitane pulo iku dipanggoni dening Tainos lan Caribes. Suku Caribes yaiku wong-wong sing omong Arawakan sing tekan antarane taun 10.000 BCE.
text_en: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: Ing sawetara taun sakwise tekane penjelajah Eropa, populasi ing Tainos wis suda kanthi signifikan dening penjajah Spanyol.
text_en: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Miturut Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) antarane 1492 lan 1498 penjajah Spanyol mateni kira-kira 100.000 Taínos.
text_en: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardín de la Unión. Ruang iki dibangun minangka atrium kanggo konvensi abad kaping-17, ing ngendi Templo de San Diego iku bangunan siji-sijine sing isih ana.
text_en: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Iki saiki fungsine minangka alun-alun pusat, lan tansah duwe akeh hal kedadean, awan lan bengi.
text_en: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Ana akeh warung ana ing saubengan taman kuwi, lan nalika awan lan sore uga ana konser gratis sing saka njero gazebo punjer.
text_en: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejon del Beso (Gang Ambungan). Rong balkon sing kapisah mung 69 sentimeter yaiku omah saka legenda katresnan lawas.
text_en: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Kanggo sawetara sen, bocah-bocah bakal nyritakake crita kasebut marang sampeyan.
text_en: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: Pulo Bowen iku wisata sedina utawa akhir minggu sing didhemeni nawarake kayak, munggah gunung, toko-toko, restoran, lan liyane.
text_en: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Pakumpulan asli iki dumunung ing Howe Sound adoh saka Vancouver, lan gampang dagayuh liwat becak banyu sing wis dijadwal sing budhal saka Pulo Granville ing pusat kutha Vancouver.
text_en: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Kanggo sing seneng kamempengan ing njaba omah, mlaku turut ing pinggiring gang Laut menyang Langit penting banget.
text_en: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Whistler (1,5 jam nyupir saka Vancouver) larang nanging misuwur ing Olimpiade Mangsa Panas 2010.
text_en: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: Ing mangsa adhem, seneng-senenga liwat sawetara panggonan ski paling apik ing Amerika Lor, lan ing mangsa panas nyobaa pit-pitan liwat gunung sing asli.
text_en: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Idin kudu dipesen luwih dhisik. Sampeyan kudu duwe idin kanggo nginep ing Sirena.
text_en: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Sirena iku siji- sijine penjaga stasiun sing nawani penginapan asrama lan panganan panas saliyane kanggo kemah. La Leona, San Pedrillo, lan Los Patos namung nawakake kemah tanpa layanan panganan.
