text_en: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Dimungkinake kanggo oleh idin taman langsung saka Pos Penjaga ing Puerto Jiménez, nanging dheweke ora nampa kertu kredit.
text_en: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: Layanan Taman (MINAE) ora ngetokake idin taman luwih saka sewulan sadurunge, saka karawuhan sing diarepake.
text_en: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: CafeNet El Sol nawakake layanan pesenan kanthi rega 30 dolar, utawa 10 dolar kanggo tiket sedina; rincian ing halaman Corcovadone.
text_en: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Kapuloan Cook iku negara pulo ing asosiasi bebas karo Selandia Baru, panggonane ing Polinesia, ing tengah-tengah Samudra Pasifik Kidul.
text_en: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: Iki kepuloan kanthi 15 pulo nyebar ngliwati 2,2 yuta km2 segara.
text_en: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Kanthi tlatah wektu sing padha karo Hawaii, pulo-pulo mau uga dianggep minangka "Hawaii ing ngisor".
text_en: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Sanajan luwih cilik, iku ngengetake sawetara dhayoh tua saka Hawaii sadurunge dadi negara bagean tanpa kabeh hotel-hotel plancong sing gedhe lan kemajuan liane.
text_en: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Kepuloan Cook ora duwe kutha nanging kasusun saka 15 pulau sing beda. Sing utama yaiku Rarotonga lan Aitutaki.
text_en: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Ning negara maju saiki, nyedhiyakake kasur sing apik lan sarapan wis dianggep dadi wujud-seni.
text_en: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: Ana pucuke, B&Bs cetho banget yen tarung utamane ana rong perkara: amben lan sarapan.
text_en: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Mula amarga iku, ana papan sing paling apik kaya iku uwong gampang kanggo nemokake amben paling mewah, mungkin slimut kapas gawenan tangan utawa sawijining tempat turu antik.
text_en: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: Sarapan bisa nyakup panganan khas dhaerah sing usum utawa pampadan khas saka tuwan umah.
text_en: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: Latare bisa uga bangunan tuwa bersejarah kanthi perabot kuno, latar sing dirawat lan kolam renang.
text_en: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Mlebu menyang njero montormu lan mlaku menyang plesiran sing adoh nduweni daya tarik sing alami lan sederhana nanging nyenengke.
text_en: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: Ora kaya kendharaan sing luwih gedhe, sampeyan paling wis kenal karo carane nyopir montormu lan mangerteni watesan-watesane.
text_en: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Ngedekake tendha ing lemah duweke dhewe pribadi utawa ing kutha kanthi ukuran pira wae bisa narik kawigaten sing ora dipengini.
text_en: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: Ringkese, nggunakake mobilmu minangka cara sing apik kanggo lelungan, nanging arang banget "kemah" nalika lunga ijen.
text_en: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Kemah mobil iku mungkin yen sampeyan duwe minivan gedhe, SUV, Sedan utawa Gerbong Stasiun kanthi kursi-kursi sing diglethakake.
text_en: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Sawetara hotel duweni warisan saka mangsa keemasan kereta uap lan kapal laut; sakdurunge Perang Donya keloro, ing abad ke 19 utawa awal abad ke 20.
text_en: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: Hotel-hotel iki jaman dhisike ana ngendi wong-wong sugih lan terkenal ing masane bakal nginep, lan asring mangan wengi lan kegiatan wengi.
text_en: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: Prabot mode kuna, kurange fasilitas paling anyar, lan umur sing anggun iku uga perangan karaktere dheweke padha.
text_en: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Sanajan biasane duweke pribadi, nanging dheweke asring ngladheni pamimpin negara lan pejabat liyane.
text_en: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Wong lelungan karo tumpukan dhuwit bisa uga nimbang lelungan muter-muter donya, bubar kanthi nginep ing lusmen-lusmen kasebut.
text_en: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Jaringan pertukaran mertamu iku organisasi sing ngubungake pelancong karo wong lokal ing kutha-kutha sing dheweke ameh tekani.
text_en: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Kanggo melu jaringan biyasane mung kudu ngisi formulir daring; sanajan sawetara jaringan nawakake utawa mbutuhake pambukten tambahan.
text_en: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Urutan wong sing bisa nyedhiyani omah kanggo nginep banjur disedhiyakake kanthi dicethak utawa onlen, kadang kala kanthi acuan lan ulasan sing digawe dening wong sing nginep.
text_en: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Couchsurfing didegake ing Januari 2004 sawise programer komputer Casey Fenton nemokake penerbangan murah menyang Islandia nanging ora duwe papan kanggo nginep.
text_en: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: Dheweke ngirimke surat elektronik marang siswane ana universitas lokal lan nrima akeh banget tawaran akomodasi gratis.
text_en: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Asrama mung ngladheni wong enom – tamu khusus sing umur rong puluhan – nanging sampeyan uga asring bisa nemokake plancong sing luwih tuwa.
text_en: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Keluwarga kanthi anak-anak iku sawijining sawangan jarang, nanging sawetara pondhokan ngidini dheweke padha ing kamar pribadi.
text_en: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: Kutha Beijing ing China bakal dadi kutha penyelenggara Olimpiade Musim Adhem Olimpiade ing 2022, sing bakal ndadekake iki kutha sepisan sing dadi tuan rumah Olimpiade musim panas lan musim adhem.
text_en: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Beijing bakal dadi tuwan omah upacara wiwitaning lan panutupan lan acara es ing njero ruangan.
text_en: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Acara ski liyane bakal ditindakake ing dhaerah ski Taizicheng ing Zhangjiakou, udakara 220 km (140 mil) saka Beijing.
text_en: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: Akeh candhi sing nduweni pagelaran Taunan wiwit ana sasi Nopember pungkasane ana Tengah Mei, beda-beda gumantung marang tanggalan taunan candhi.
text_en: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: Akeh pagelaran ana candhi kuwi dirayakne dadi bageyan ambal warsane candhi utawa dadi pangeling-eling dina kelairane dewa utawa pagelaran gedhe liyane sing ana hubungan ekaro candhi.
text_en: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Pagelaran ana ning candhi Kerala iki endah banget, kanthi urut-urutan umum nggunakake gajah sing dirias, karawitan candhi lan pagelaran-pagelaran liyane.
text_en: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: Pameran Donya (umume diarani Pameran Donya, utawa Expo) yaiku pestipal seni lan sains internasional sing gedhe banget.
text_en: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Negara-negara sing melu acara iki nuduhake pagelaran sing nyeni lan uga bisa disinau ning paviliun nasional kanggo nuduhke perkara donya utawa kabudayan negarane lan uga sejarah.
text_en: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: Eksposisi Hortikultura Internasional yaiku acara kusus sing mamerake kembang-kembang, kebon botani, lan masalah sing ana hubungane karo tanduran.
text_en: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Sanadyan teorine iku bisa dianakake saben taun (angger ana ing beda negara), ing praktike ora bisa.
text_en: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Acara iki biasane nganti tekan antarane telu lan enem sasi, lan dianakake ing panggonan sing ora luwih cilik saka 50 hektar.
text_en: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: Ana akeh format film sing beda-beda sing digunakake pirang-pirang taun suwene. FIlm 35 mm sing standar (36 ping 24 mm negatif) iku sing paling umum.
text_en: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: Biasane bisa diisi maneh kanthi gampang menawa sampeyan kentekan, lan menehi resolusi kang kira-kira bisa disandhingne karo DSLR saiki.
text_en: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Sawetara kamera film format-sedheng nggunakake format 6 ping 6 cm, luwih trep maneh negatip 56 ping 56 mm.
text_en: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Resolusine ameh ping papat saka 35 mm negatif (3136 mm2 nglawan 864).
text_en: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Margasatwa liar minangka salah sawijining modhel sing paling nantang kanggo fotografer, lan mbutuhake gabungan kabegjan, sabar, pangalaman lan piranti kang apik.
text_en: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: Pemotretan margasatwa iku kerep dianggep remeh, nanging kaya pemotretan umume, foto iku aji ewunan tembung.
text_en: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Fotografi satwa liar asring mbutuhake lensa telepoto sing dawa, sanadyan kewan-kewan kayata klompok manuk utawa kewan sing cilik mbutuhake lensa liyane
text_en: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Akeh kewan-kewan eksotik iku angel ditemokake, lan taman-taman kadhang kala duwe aturan-aturan bab njupuk foto-foto kanggo kaperluan komersial.
text_en: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Kewan liar bisa wae isin utawa galak. Lingkungane bisa wae adhem, panas, utawa suwalike satru.
text_en: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: Donya iki duwe luwih saka 5.000 basa sing beda, kalebu luwih saka rong puluh kanthi 50 yuta utawa luwih wong sing bisa ngomong.
text_en: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Tembung-tembung sing ditulis kerep luwih gampang dipahami tinimbang tembung-tembung sing dipocapake, uga. Iki utamane bener kanggo alamat, sing kerep angel dieja kanthi gampang dimangerteni.
text_en: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Akeh negara-negara sing lancar banget nggunakke basa Inggris, lan uga sampeyan bisa ngarepake ilmu sing ana watese - utamane kanggo nom-noman.
text_en: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Bayangno, yen sampeyan gelem, wong Mancunia, Boston, Jamaika lan Sydney lungguh ana ing saubengane meja mangan bareng nalika wengi ana ing restoran ning Toronto.
text_en: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Wong-wong kuwi nglipur wong liyane kanthi nyritakake crita saka desane, dicritakake kanthi logat sing beda lan penemu lokal.
text_en: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Tuku panganan ing supermarket iku biasane cara paling murah kanggo mangan. Tanpa kasempatan masak, pilihane amung diwatesi karo panganan siap saji.
text_en: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Saya akeh supermarket sing duwe bagean macem-macem saka panganan cepak saji. Sawetara malah uga nyedhiyakake oven microwave utawa piranti liyane kanggo manasne panganan.
text_en: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: Ing sawetara negara utawa tipe toko paling ora ana restoran ing panggonane, kerepe sing ora formal kanthi rega murah.
text_en: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Gawe lan gawa pertalan polis lan princian kontak pakaryan asuransimu.
text_en: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Dheweke padha butuh kanggo nuduhake alamat e-mail penjamin asuransi lan nomer telpon internasional kanggo pitutur/otorisasi lan gawe tuntutan.
text_en: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Duweni salinan liya ing gawan sampeyan lan online (kirim e-mail menyang sampeyan dhewe nganggo lampiran, utawa disimpen ing “cloud”).
text_en: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Menawa lelungan karo nggawa laptop utawa tablet, simpenen salinan ing memori utawa piringane (bisa diakses tanpa internet).
text_en: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Uga wenehi pertalan kawicaksanan/kontak karo kanca lan sedulur sing lelungan utawa kanca ing omah sing gelem mbantu.
text_en: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: Kidang Gedhe (uga diarani kidang) ora seneng nyerang dhewe-dhewe, nanging bakal mbela awake yen ana anceman.
text_en: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Nalika manungsa ora nganggep kidang kuwi mbebayani, si kidang bisa nyedhak cedhak banget lan justru mbebayani awake dhewe.
text_en: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Aja ngombe alkohol kanthi jumlah sing akeh. Alkohol nduweni pengaruh sing beda-beda kanggo manungsa, lan mangerteni watesanmu kuwi penting banget.
text_en: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Kedadean kasarasan jangka panjang sing mungkin saka ngombe kakean bisa kalebu kerusakan ati lan senajan wuta lan mati. Potensi bebayane mundhak nalika nganggo produk alkohol ilegal.
text_en: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: Alkohol kesit bisa ngemot macem-macem regedan sing mbebayani kalebu métanol, sing bisa nyebabake buta utawa pati sanajan dosis cilik.
text_en: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Kacamata bisa dadi luwih murah ing negara asing, apa maneh ing negara-negara pendapatan cendhak ing ngendi rega tenaga buruh luwih murah.
text_en: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Pertimbangke mriksakake mripat ing omah, mligine yen ditanggung asuransi, lan nggawa resepe terus diajokake ing panggon liyane.
text_en: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Wengku jeneng merek modheren sing kasedhiya ing dhaerah kasebut bisa uga duwe rong masalah; sawetara bisa uga tiron, lan sing diimpur bisa uga luwih larang tinimbang sing ning omah.
text_en: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Kopi kuwi salah sawijine barang dagangan sing paling payu, lan sampeyan uga bisa nemokake akeh jinis ana ning wilayahmu dhewe.
text_en: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Sanajan mengkono, ana akeh cara-cara beda kanggo ngombe kopi ing saindeging bawana sing patut dicoba.
text_en: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Canyoning (utawa: canyoneering) iku babagan lunga ing dhasar canyon, sing garing utawa kebak banyu.
text_en: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: Canyoning nggabungake unsur-unsur saka nglangi, menek lan mlumpat--nanging mbutuhake panglantih utawa bekukan jasmani sethithik kanggo miwiti (dibandhingake karo menek bambing, nyilem scuba utawa ski alpin, contone).
text_en: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Mlaku munggah gunung kuwi kagiyatan ana njaba omah sing kalebu mlaku ana ning lingkungan alam, asring ana jalur munggah gunung.
text_en: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Munggah gunung wayah awan kalebu sing adohe luwih sithik saka sak mile nganti sing luwih adoh maneh sing bisa dirampungne sedina.
text_en: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Kanggo munggah gunung sedina sadawane dalan sing gampang persiapan sing dibutuhake iku sathithik, lan wong sing kabugarane sedhengan bisa melu.
text_en: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Kulawarga kanthi bocah cilik-cilik bisa uga butuh persiapan luwih, nanging sedina ing njaba iku bisa gampang kelakon sanadyan karo bayi lan bocah durung sekolah.
text_en: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: Miturut cathetan internasional, ana 200 organisasi sing ngurusi perkara plesiran. Akeh banget sing mlaku kanthi mandiri.
text_en: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: Pengganti Perjalanan Mlayu Sajagad, Perjalanan Mlayu Lunga jaringan lusinan panyadhiya penglihatan ing papat benua.
text_en: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Wiwit saka Barcelona's Running Tours ing Barcelona lan Copenhagen's Running ing Copenhagen, kegiyatan kuwi enggal ditututi karo Running Tours Prague sing pusate ing Praha lan kegiyatan liyane.
text_en: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Akeh banget sing kudu dipikirke sadurunge lan nalika sampeyan kepingin plesir.
text_en: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Nalika sampeyan lelungan, kudu siap menawa apa-apa ora padha nalikane “ana omah”. Tata krama, ukum, panganan, lalu lintas, penginepan, standar, basa, lan liyane bakal rada beda karo papan asal sampeyan.
text_en: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Iki minangka perkara sing kudu sampeyan eling, supaya ora kuciwa utawa uga ora seneng karo cara lokal kanggo nindakake prekara.
text_en: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Agen wisata wis ana wiwit abad 19. Agen wisata iku biasane pilihan sing apik kanggo lelungan sing ngluwihi pengalaman pelancong sadurunge kanthi alam, budhaya, basa utawa negara-negara sing pendapatane sithik.
text_en: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Sanadyan sebagean gedhe agensi gelem njupuk sebagean gedhe pemesanan biasa, akeh agen sing ngususake ing lelungan jinis tartamtu, gedhene anggaran utawa jujugan.
text_en: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Iki bisa dadi luwih apik kanggo nggunakake sawijining agen sing kerep mesen perjalanan padha karo sampeyan.
text_en: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Coba delengen wisata apa sing dipromosikke dening agen iki, ana ning situs web utawa ana cendhela kaca toko.
text_en: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: Yen sampeyan pengin ndeleng donya kanthi murah, kanggo kabutuhan, pacak urip utawa tantangan, ana sawetara cara kanggo nindakake.
text_en: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: Sejatine, dheweke dibagi dadi rong pepanthan: Bisa nyambut gawe nalika sampeyan lelungan utawa watesi becer. Artikel iki dklumpukake ing babagan wusana.
text_en: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Kanggo sapa wae sing kepengin ngrelakake kasenengan iki, wanci lan ramalan supaya saya murah, deleng anggaran plesir sing paling murah.
text_en: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: Saran kasebut nganggep menawa para turis ora nyolong, mlebu tanpa ijin, melu ing pasar ilegal, ngemis, utawa ngeksploitasi wong liya kanggo untunge dhewe.
text_en: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: Titik priksa imigrasi kuwi biyasane dadi panggonan wiwitan nalika medhun saka montor mabur, kapal, utawa kendharaan liyane.
text_en: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: Ing pira-pira sepur lintas batas inspeksi ditindakake ing sepur sing nembe mlaku lan sampeyan kudune duwe identitas sing bener karo sampeyan nalika numpak salah siji saka sepur-sepur iku.
text_en: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: Kreta turu wengi, paspor diklumpukke dening kondektur supaya ora kaganggu nalika sampeyan turu.
text_en: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: Pancathetan minangka wewaton tambahan kanggo nyawisake visa. Ing sawetara negara, sampeyan kudu nyathet karawuhan lan tetenger karo panguwasa ing kana.
text_en: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: Iki bisa uga mbutuhake ngisi formulir karo polisi lokal utawa nekani kantor imigrasi.
text_en: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: Ing pirang-pirang negara sing duwe angger-angger kasebut, hotel-hotel lokal bakal nangani pancathetan (mesthekake sampeyan takon).
text_en: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: Ing kasus liya, mung wong sing nginep sak njabane akomodasi turis sing kudu ndaftar. Nanging, iki ndadekake aturane luwih ketutup, mula sampeyan temokake sakdurunge.
text_en: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: Arsitektur kuwi nggatekake banget karo rancangan lan bangunan gedhung. Arsitektur panggonan iki asring dadi daya tarik sing khas sing disenengi dening turis
text_en: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: Akeh bangunan sing lumayan apik disawang lan pemandangan saka bangunan sing dhuwur utawa cendhela sing dipanggonke kanthi pinter bisa endah disawang.
text_en: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: Rancangan bangunan tumpang tindih karo bidang liyane kalebu rancangan kutha, teknik sipil, seni dekorasi, rancangan njero omah lan rancangan bentang alam.
text_en: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: Kelingan akehe jumlah wong pueblos, sampeyan ora bakal bisa nemokake urip nalika wengi tanpa dolan menyang Albuquerque utawa Santa Fe.
text_en: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text: Nanging, ameh kabeh kasino sing kasebut ing dhuwur nyediyani ombenan, lan sawetarane nyediyani hiburan berkelas (utamane sing gedhe-gedhe sing ana cedhake Albuquerque lan Santa Fe).
text_en: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

text: Ati-ati: bar-bar ing kutha cilik kene ora mesthi papan sing apik kanggo dolan dhayoh luar negri.
text_en: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

text: Kanggo sakperkara, New Meksiko Lor duwe masalah penting karo nyetir nalika mendem, lan konsentrasi saka sopir sing mendem cedhak karo bar ing kutha cilik.
text_en: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

text: Mural utawa orek-orekan sing ora dikepengini iku arane grafiti.
text_en: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.

text: Sanajan adoh saka pristiwa modheren, umume wong bisa nggandhengake dheweke karo wong enom sing ngrusak prabot umum lan pribadi nggunakake cet semprot.
text_en: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

text: Nanging, saiki ana seniwan grafiti mapan, acara grafiti lan tembok "rasmi". Gegambaran grafiti ing kahanan iki asring meh padha karo karya seni tinimbang tandha sing ora bisa diwaca.
text_en: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.

text: Nguncalake boomerang iku ketrampilan populer sing pengin dirambah akeh wisatawan.
text_en: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.

text: Yen sampeyan kepingin sinau nyawatake bumerang sing bisa bali maneh menyang tanganmu, pestekno sampeyan nduwe bumerang sing cocog lan bisa bali.
text_en: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.

text: Akeh-akeh bumerang sing sumedya ing Australia sejatine ora bisa dibalekake. Iki sing paling apik kanggo pemula kanggo ora njajal nguncalke ing angin.
text_en: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy

text: Masakan Hangi iku dimasak ing bolongan panas ing jero lemah.
text_en: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

text: Bolongan kuwi dipanaske nggunakake watu panas saka geni, utawa ana panggonan tartamtu nggunakake panass bumi sing gawe panas kanthi alami.
text_en: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.

text: Hangi kerep digunakake kanggo masak masakan jenis bakaran tradisional.
text_en: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.

text: Ana pirang-pirang panggonan ning Rotorua sing nawakke hangi panas bumi, lan hangi liyane bisa dijukuk ning Christchurch, Wellington lan panggonan liyane.
text_en: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.

text: RelMetro nduwe kelas loro ana sepur komuter ana njero lan ana sekitare Cape Town: MetroPlus (uga diarani Kelas Utama) lan Metro (diarani Kelas Katelu).
text_en: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

text: MetroPlus iku luwih kepenak lan ora pati rame nanging rada larang sathithik, sandyan isih luwih murah katimbang tiket metro sing lumrah ing Eropa.
text_en: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

text: Saben sepur nduweni MetroPlus lan uga gerbong Metro; gerbong MetroPlus mesthi ana mburine sepur sing paling cedhak menyang Cape Town.
text_en: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

text: Nggawa kanggo liyane - Aja nganti lali karo tasmu, kususe nalika sampeyan nyebrang watesan internasional.
text_en: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.

text: Sampeyan bisa nemokake awake sampeyan dhewe digunakake minangka penyebar racun tanpa sampeyan mangerteni, sing bakal gawe sampeyan ngalami masalah.
text_en: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.

text: Iki kalebu antri, kaya segawon tukang ngambu-narkoba bisa digunakake kapan wae tanpa nggatekake.
text_en: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.

text: Sawetara negara duwe ukuman sing cukat banget sanajan kanggo kaluputan sing pisanan; iki bisa kalebu ukara kunjara luwih saka 10 taun utawa mati.
text_en: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.

text: Tas sing ora dijaga menawa pangincengan maling lan uga bisa narik perhatosan para petugas sing waspaos marang anceman bom.
text_en: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.

text: Ning omah, amarga paparan kuman lokal sing terus-terusan iki, ana kasempatan yen sampeyan kebal marang barang iki.
text_en: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

text: Nanging ing bagean liya ing donya, ing ngendi bangsa kewan bakteri anyar kanggo sampeyan, sampeyan bisa uga bakal kena masalah.
text_en: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.

text: Uga, ing mangsa sing luwih anget, bakteri tuwuh luwih cepet lan tahan luwih suwe ing njaba awak.
text_en: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.

text: Mangkono iku momok Weteng Delhi, Sepatane Firaun, Piwalesan Dhendham Montezuma, lan akeh kancane dheweke padha.
text_en: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.

text: Kaya masalah ambegan ing iklim adhem, masalah usus ing iklim panas iku cukup biasa lan ing sebagean gedhe kasus iku nganyelake banget nanging ora pati mbebayani.
text_en: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.

text: Menawa lelungan menyang negara berkembang kanggo sing sepisan - utawa ing sisih anyar saka donya - aja ngremehake kemungkinan kaget babagan budhaya.
text_en: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.

text: Akeh wisatawan sing mampu lan stabil wis diatasi dening pangrembakaning donya perjalanan kang anyar, ing ngendi akeh penyesuaian kabudayan cilik bisa tambah kanthi cepet.
text_en: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.

text: Kususe ning dina-dina wiwitanmu, aja lali mikirne kemungkinan kanggo belanja kanggo gaya-Kulonanmu lan -hotel sing larang, panganan, lan layanan kanggo mbantu ngepaske awak.
text_en: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.

text: Aja turu ana matras utawa bantalan ning lemah ana daerah sing ora sampeyan mangerteni kewan-kewan lokale.
text_en: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.

text: Yen sampeyan bakal kemah, ojo lali nggawa kranjang kemah utawa amben gantung supaya adoh saka ula, kalajengking utawa kewan liyane.
text_en: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.

text: Isi omahe sampeyan kanthi kopi kenthel ing wayah esuk lan sawetara teh chamomile sing marai santai ing wayah bengi.
text_en: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.

text: Nalika sampeyan ana ing staycation, sampeyan duwe wektu kanggo ngrawat sampeyan dhewe lan njupuk sawetara menit tambahan kanggo masak sesuatu khusus.
text_en: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.

text: Menawa sampeyan rumangsa luwih kendel, jupuk kesempatan kanggo gawe sari wuh-wuhan utawa nyampur sawetara smoothie.
text_en: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

text: bisa wae sampeyan nemokake ombenan sing sederhana sing bisa sampeyan gawe kanggo sarapan nalika wis bali kaya adate.
text_en: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.

text: Yen sampeyan manggon ing kutha sing duwe budaya ngombe macem-macem, pindhah menyang bar utawa omah kusus omben ing dhaerah sakubengmu ora kerep kok tekani.
text_en: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.

text: Kanggo sapa kang awam karo jargon medis, tembung infeksi lan nular duwe teges kang beda.
text_en: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

text: Lelaran sing nular yaiku lelaran sing disebabake dening patogen, kayata virus, bakteri, jamur utawa parasit liyane.
text_en: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

text: Penyakit nular yaiku penyakit sing gampang pindhah kanthi ana ing sekitare wong sing kena.
text_en: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.

text: Akeh pemerintah majibake dhayoh mlebu, utawa penduduk lunga, negarane divaksinasi kanggo maneka warna penyakit.
text_en: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

text: Syarat-syarat iki biyasane gumantung marang negara sing kepingin ditekani dening wisatawan.
text_en: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.

text: Salah sawijine bab sing kuwat saka Charlotte, North Carolina, yaiku kutha iki nduweni akeh pilihan kanthi kualitas-apik kanggo kaluwarga.
text_en: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.

text: Warga saka wilayah liya asring ngujarake ramah kaluwarga minangka alesan utama kanggo pindhah rana, lan para tamu asring nemokake kuthane gampang nyenengake karo anane bocah-bocah cilik.
text_en: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.

text: Saka 20 taun kepungkur, jumlah pilihan sing ramah anak ing Uptown Charlotte wis mundhak kanthi cepet.
text_en: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.

text: Umume taksi ora digunakake dening kaluwarga ning Charlotte, sanadyan bisa digunakake kanggo kahanan tartamtu.
text_en: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.

text: Ana tarif tambahan kanggo duwe luwih saka 2 penumpang, mula pilian iki bisa luwih larang saka sing dibutuhake.
text_en: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

text: Antartika minangka papan sing paling adhem ing Bumi, lan ngubengi Kutub Kidul.
text_en: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

text: Layatan turis iku larang, sing butuh kasarasan, mung bisa ditindakake ing wulan Nopémber-Februari, lan angsring diwatesi ing Semenanjung, Kapulaoan lan Segara Ross.
text_en: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

text: Pirang-pirang ewu staf urip ing kene ing mangsa panas ing watara patang lusin pangkalan sing paling akeh ing wewengkon kana; sagunggung cilik nginep sasuwene mangsa adhem.
text_en: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.

text: Punjere Antartika kuwi palemahan sing katutup dening es sing ambane 2-3 km.
text_en: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

text: Wisata udhara ahli kala-kala mlebu kampung, munggah gunung utawa tekan kutub, sing nduwe pangkalan gedhe.
text_en: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

text: Jalur Kutub Kidul (utawa dalan Tol) kuwi dalan sing dawane 1600km saka Stasiun McMurdo saka Laut Ross menyang Kutub.
text_en: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

text: Iki salju sing dipadhetke kanthi tembelan lan ditandhani dening gendera. Mung bisa diliwati dening traktor khusus, kreta mluncur karo bensin lan sangu.
text_en: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

text: Iku ora pati cepet dadi tipake kudu dijupuk sadawane penggokan sakiwa tengene Pegunungan Transacctic kanggo menyang ing dataran tinggi.
text_en: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

text: penyebab paling umum kacilakan ing mangsa adhem yaiku dalan lunyu, troroar (trotoar) lan mligine langkah-langkah.
text_en: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

text: Paling ora sampeyan butuh ales sikil kanthi sol sing patut. Sepatu mangsa panas biasane lunyu banget ing es lan salju, malah sawetara sepatu but mangsa adhem ya kurang.
text_en: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

text: Pola iki kudune jero, 5 mm (1/5 inci) utawa luwih, lan materi iki cukup alus nalika hawane adem.
text_en: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

text: Pira-pira sepatu bot duwe tatahan lan ana piranti tambahan sing semebar kanggo kahanan lunyu, pas kanggo akeh-akeh sepatu lan sepatu bot, kanggo tungkak utawa tungkak lan sol.
text_en: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

text: Tungkak kudu cendhek lan jembar. Pasir, krakal utawa uyah (kalsium klorida) asring mecer-mecer ana ratan utawa dalan kanggo nambahi gesekan.
text_en: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text: Lemah longsor iku dudu barang sing ora lumrah; dronjongan mung bisa nahen alon-alon sautara, lan isi sing luber bakal mudhun dadi longsor.
text_en: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text: Perkarane yaiku menawa salju iku lengket, dadi iki butuh pemicu kanggo medhun, lan sawetara salju medhun bisa dadi kedadean pemicu kanggo sisane.
text_en: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

text: Kadhangkala pristiwa sing miwiti yaiku srengenge sing ngangeti salju, kadhang salju mudhun luwih akeh, kadhang kedadeyan pristiwa alam liyane, asringe manungsa.
text_en: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text: Topan minangka puteran kokem sing duwe tekanan hawa cendhek banget, sing nyedhot hawa ing saubenging mlebu lan munggah.
text_en: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text: Dheweke ngasilake angin sing kuwat (asring 100-200 mil/jam) lan bisa ngangkat barang-barang abot menyang udhara, nggawa dheweke nalika angin topan obah.
text_en: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text: Wiwitane bakal maujud kayata corong saka mendhung sing peteng, banjur dadi “lesus” nalika tekan ngisor.
text_en: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: Panyedhiya VPN pribadi (jaringan pribadi virtual) yaiku cara paling apik kanggo mbukak panyensuran politik lan IP-geofilter komersial.
text_en: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: Dheweke luwih unggul tinimbang proksi jaringan kanthi alesan: dheweke ngelih jalur lalu lintas internet, ora mung http.
text_en: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text: Biyasane dheweke nawakke bandwith sing luwih dhuwur lan kualitas layanan sing luwih apik. Tur uga dienkripsi saingga angel dideleng.
text_en: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: Perusahaan-perusahaan media kanthi ajeg ngapusi babagan ancas iki, ngaku menawa iki iku kanggo "nyegah pembajakan".
text_en: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: Ing nyatane kode wilayah ora duwe pengaruh temenan marang salinan sing ora sah; sethithik baka sethithik disk bakal diputer kanthi apik ing piranti ngendi wae sing asli.
text_en: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text: Ancas sing satemene yaiku kanggo menehi perusahaan-perusahaan iku kontrol sing luwih marang pemasarane; iki iku kabeh babagan puteraning dhuwit.
text_en: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: Amarga panggilan disalurake liwat Internet, sampeyan ora perlu nggunakake telpon perusahaan sing ana ing ngendi sampeyan manggon utawa ing ngendi sampeyan lelungan.
text_en: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: Uga ora ana sarat supaya sampeyan entuk nomer lokal saka komunitas ing panggon sampeyan; Sampeyan bisa entuk sambungan Internet satelit ing alas gedhe Pitik, Alaska lan milih nomer sing nyatakake sampeyan ing Arizona sing crah.
text_en: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: Asring, sampeyan kudu tuku nomer global kanthi kapisah sing ngidini tilpun PSTN ngubungi sampeyan. Nomer kasebut ndadekake prabéda kanggo wong sing nilpun sampeyan.
text_en: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: Aplikasi penerjemah teks wektu nyata – aplikasi sing bisa otomatis nerjemahake kabeh perangan teks saka siji bahasa dadi basa liyane.
text_en: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: Sawetara aplikasi ing kategori iki uga malah bisa nerjemahne tulisan ing basa asing ing tandha utawa barang liya ing kasunyatan nalika panganggone ngarahne smartphone tumrap barang-barang kasebut.
text_en: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: Mesin terjemahan kuwi wis dadi saya apik, lan saiki asring menehi kurang luwih asil terjemahan sing luwih pener (lan luwih arang omong kosong), nanging tetp kudu digatekake, amarga isih ana sing kleru.
text_en: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: Salah sawijine aplikasi sing paling katon ana pilihan iki yaiku Google Terjemahan, sing bisa mbantu ngartekke ukara tanpa perlu kaubung internet sabubare ngundhuh data basa sing dipengini.
text_en: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: Nggunakake aplikasi nasvigasi GPS ing ponsel pinter sampeyan bisa dadi cara sing paling gampang lan paling pas kanggo navigasi nalika metu saka negara asal sampeyan.
text_en: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: Tuku peta anyar kanggo GPS kuwi bisa ngirit dhuwit, utawa GPS sing mandiri utawa nyewa saka perusahaan sing nyewakake montor.
text_en: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: Yen sampeyan ora duwe sambungan dhata kanggo tilpunmu, utawa yen sampeyan ora ana ing ranggehan, asil bisa uga diwatesi utawa ora kasedhiya.
text_en: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: Saben pojokan toko diisi karo jejeran kertu telepon prabayar sing mbingungake sing bisa digunakake saka telepon umum utawa telepon sing biyasa.
text_en: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: Nalika umume kertu apik kanggo nilpun ing ngendi wae, sawetara khusus nyedhiyakake beya tilpun sing nguntungake kanggo klompok negara tartamtu.
text_en: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

text: Akses menyang layanan iku kerep liwat nomor telepon bebas pulsa sing bisa ditelpon saka saperangan akeh talpon tanpa bea.
text_en: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: Paugeran babagan pemotretan biasa uga berlaku kanggo rekaman video, bahkan mungkin luwih.
text_en: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

text: Yen mung moto wae ora diidini, sampeyan kudune ora malah kepikiran ngrekam videone iku.
text_en: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: Menawa nggunakake sawijining pesawat tanpa awak, priksa kanthi apik kayata apa sing sampeyan oleh filmke lan ijin utawa surat ijin tambahan apa sing dibutuhake.
text_en: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: Ngaburne drone cedhak bandara utawa kerumunan iku tansah dadi gagasan sing ala, sanadyan iku ora ilegal ing wilayah sampeyan.
text_en: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

text: Saiki perjalanan udara jarang dipesen langsung liwat maskapai tanpa pencarian pisanan lan rega pembanding.
text_en: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

text: Kadhangkala panerbangan sing padha bisa duwe rega beda ing macem-macem pangumpul lan mbayar kanggo mbandhingake asil telusuran lan uga ndeleng situs web maskape sadurunge menehi pesenan.
text_en: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: Sanadyan sampeyan ora mbutuhake visa nalika dolan menyang negara tartamtu dadi turis utawa kanggo nyambut gawe, mara menyang nagara kasebut dadi siswa internasional biyasane bakal mbutuhake wektu sing suwe tinimbang nalika dolan mrana mung dadi turis.
text_en: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: Umume, manggon ing negara luar negri ngendi wae kanggo wektu sing suwe bakal meksa sampeyan kanggo entuk visa luwih dhisik.
text_en: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

text: Visa pelajar umume duwe persyaratan lan prosedur aplikasi sing beda saka visa turis utawa bisnis.
text_en: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

text: Kanggo sebagean gedhe negara, sampeyan bakal mbutuhake layang tawaran saka institusi ing ngendi sampeyan pengin sinau, lan uga bukti dana kanggo ngopeni sampeyan paling ora taun sepisan kuliah sampeyan.
text_en: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: Priksa karo pakulitan, uga bagean imigrasi kanggo negara sing pengin sampeyan tuju kanggo sinau kanggo ngerti wewaon sing kumplit.
text_en: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: Kajaba sampeyan diplomat, kerja ing luar negeri umume iku tegese sampeyan kudu ngajokake pajek penghasilan ing negara sampeyan kerja.
text_en: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: Pajeg pangasilan disungsun kanthi beda ing masing-masing negara, lan rega pajeg lan kurung pajeg akeh maceme saka negara siji marang liyane.
text_en: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: Ing sawetara negara federal, kayata Amerika Serikat lan Kanada, pajek penghasilan iku ditarik ing tingkat pamarentah pusat lan ing tingkat daerah, satemah tarip lan golongan bisa beda saka daerah siji lan daerah liyane.
text_en: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: Sanadyan pamriksaan imigrasi biasane ora ana utawa mung formalitas nalika sampeyan tekan ing negara asal, bea cukai bisa ngrepoti.
text_en: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: Priksa manawa sampeyan ngerti apa sing bisa lan ora bisa nggawa lan nyatakake apa wae ing wewaton.
text_en: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: Cara paling gampang kanggo miwiti bisnis nulis lelungan yaiku kanthi ngasah ketrampilan sampeyan ing situs web lelungan sing wis mapan.
text_en: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: Sabubare sampeyan rumangsa kepenak karo format lan edit ana ning web, sabubare, sampeyan bakal gawe situs web mu dhewe.
text_en: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Dadi relawan nalika plesir kuwi cara sing apik banget kanggo gawe pambeda nanging ora mung perkara menehi.
text_en: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: Urip lan dadi sukarelawan ning negara asing kuwi dadi cara sing apik kanggo ngenal kabudayan liyane, ketemu wong anyar, ngenali awakmu dhewe, nduweni sudhut sesawangan lan uga nduweni kemampuan anyar.
text_en: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: Iki uga bisa dadi cara sing apik kanggo ngrenggangake anggaran supaya netep luwih suwe ing sawijining panggon amarga akeh pakaryan sukarela nyedhiyakake kamar lan dhaharan lan sawetara ngupahi sithik.
text_en: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: Viking migunakake dalan banyu Russia kanggo menyang Segara Ireng lan Segara Caspian. Sebagean saka dalan iki isih digunakake. Periksanen apa sing dibutuhake kanggo idin kusus, sing bisa wae angel olehe.
text_en: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: Laut Putih—Kanal Baltik sing nyambungke Segara Arktik menyang Segara Baltik, liwat Tlaga Onega, Tlaga Ladoga lan Saint Petersburg, kanthi kali lan tlaga.
text_en: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: Danau Onega uga dihubungake menyang Volga, saengga teka saka Laut Caspian liwat Rusia isih bisa.
text_en: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: Sampeyan kudu yakin nalikane tekan pelabuhan kabeh bakal dadi jelas. Sampeyan bakal nemoni wong liya kang nunut prau lan dheweke bakal mbagekake informasine marang sampeyan.
text_en: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: Dhasare sampeyan bakal masang wara-wara nawarne pitulungan sampeyan, wira-wiri ing dermaga, nyedaki wong kang ngresiki kapal pesiare, nyoba kenalan karo pelaut ana ing bar, lsp.
text_en: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: Cobanen ngomong karo wong saakeh-akehe. Sakwise sawetara wektu kabeh wong bakal kenal sampeyan lan bakal menehi sampeyan petunjuk prau endi sing nggoleki wong.
text_en: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: Sampeyan kudu milih maskape Frequent Flyer sampeyan ing aliansi kanthi ati-ati.
text_en: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: Sanajan sampeyan isa uga mikir iku adhedhasar intuisi kanggo gabung maskapai sing paling kerep sampeyan mabur, sampeyan kudune sadar menawa hak-hak istimewa sing ditawakake kerep beda lan frekuensi poin pilot isa uga luwih akeh ing sangisore maskapai sing beda ing perserikatan sing pada.
text_en: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: Maskapai kayata Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Maskapai Turkish wis ngembangake layanane tekan Afrika, lan nyuguhake sambungan menyang pirang-pirang kutha gedhe ing Afrika kanthi tarip sing luwih murah tinimbang maskapai Eropa.
text_en: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: Turkish Airlines mabur menyang 39 jujugan saka 30 negara Afrika awit taun 2014.
text_en: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: Menawa sampeyan duwe wektu lelungan tambahan, periksanen kanggo ndelok kepriye arahan tarip total menyang Afrika dibandingake karo tarip ngubengi donya.
text_en: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: Aja lali kanggo nambahke bea tambahan visa tambahan, pajek menyang, angkutan dharat, lan liya-liyane. kanggo kabeh papan ing sanjabaning Afrika iku.
text_en: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text: Yen sampeyan kepingin mabur ana Sisih Kidul donya, pilihan tujuan lan jalur mabure sithik banget amarga jalur lintas segara kuwi sithik banget.
text_en: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text: Ora ana aliansi maskapai sing nyakup penyebrangan kabeh telung segara ing laut sisih kidul (lan SkyTeam ora nyakup salah sijining penyebrangan).
text_en: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: Nanging, Aliansi Bintang nanggung kabeh biayane kajaba Pasifik Kidul bageyan wetan saka Santiago de Chili menyang Tahiti, sing diarani LATAM mabur Sakdonya.
text_en: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text: Penerbangan iki dudu pilihan siji-sijine menawa sampeyan pengin ora liwat Pasifik Kidul lan pesisir wetan Amerika Kidul. (delok ngisor iki)
text_en: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

text: Taun 1994, daerah etnis Suku Armenia Nagorno-Karabakh saka Azerbijan perang nglawan Azeris.
text_en: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

text: Kanthi dhukungane uwong Armenia, republik sing anyar diciptakake. Nanging, ora ana bangsa sing mapan - uga dudu Armenia - kanthi resmi ngakoni republik iki.
text_en: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

text: Alesan diplomatis perkara kawasan kuwi gawe hubungan Armenia lan Azerbaijan dadi ora rukun.
text_en: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

text: Kabupaten Kanal (Basa Belanda: Grachtengordel) kuwi kabupaten sing misuwur banget nalika abad pitulas diubengi dening Binnenstad Amsterdam.
text_en: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

text: Sak wilayah didadekake minangka Situs Warisan Donya UNESCO amarga ajine saka budhaya lan sejarah sing unik, lan rega propertine kalebu antarane sing paling dhuwur ing negarane.
text_en: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

text: Cinque Terre, sing artine Lima Dharatan, dumadi saka limang desa cilik ing desa Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza lan Monterosso sing dumunung ing wilayah Italia Liguria.
text_en: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

text: Iku didaptar ing daptar Warisan Donya UNESCO.
text_en: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

text: Atusan taun, manungsa mbangun latar ana ndhuwur tembok kanthi ngati-ati, sesawangan sing ndhuwur tur medeni ngadhep segara.
text_en: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

text: Salah siji pesonane yaiku kurange pembangunan korporat sing katon. Dalan-dalan, kereta lan prau nyambungake desa-desa, lan mobil ora bisa mlebu kana saka njaba.
text_en: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: Varietas basa Perancis sing dipocapake ing Belgia lan Swiss rada beda saka basa perancis sing dipocaake ing perancis, sanajan iku padha cukup mirip kanggo isa dipahami bebarengan.
text_en: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: Kususe, sistem angka ing Belgia lan Swiss sing basane Prancis duweni keanehan sathithik sing beda saka basa Prancis sing dienggo ing Prancis, lan pangucapan sawetara tembung uga rada beda.
text_en: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: Senajan mengkono kabeh wong perancis sing omongan ngango basa Belgia lan Swiss bakal sinau Basa perancis standar ing sekolah, satemah dheweke padha bakal isa mangerteni sampeyan mbok senajan sampeyan nggunakake sistem penomeran standar basa perancis.
text_en: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: Ana akeh bageyan ndonya, ngobahke tangan, kuwi nandhakake “halo.”
text_en: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: Nanging, ning Malaysia, paling ora, kanggo wong sing uri ing ndesa, tegese “mampir,” persis kaya driji sing nekuk, polah sing dituduhke dening negara sisih Kulon tartamtu, lan kudune dienggo kanggo tujuan kuwi.
text_en: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text: Mangkono uga, wong lelungan saka Inggris ing Spanyol bisa uga salah negesake tangan dadah-dadah sing nyangkut tapak tangan ndadahi (dudu wong sing didadahi) minangka sasmita kanggo bali.
text_en: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

text: Basa sing mbiyantu yaiku basa gawean utawa basa sing digawe kanthi tujuan nggampangake komunikasi ing antarane wong-wong sing bakal angel komunikasi.
text_en: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

text: Dheweke padha iku pisah saka basa pergaulan sing minangka basa alami utawa organik sing dadi dominan amarga siji alasan utawa liyane minangka sarana komunikasi antarane penutur basa liyane.
text_en: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

text: Nalika panas awan-awan, wong mlaku kuwi bisa nemoni khayalan sing gawe ayang-ayang banyu (utawa barang liyane).
text_en: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).

text: Iku kabeh bisa dadi mbebayani menawa plancong iku ngoyak lamunan, mbuang tenaga sing aji lan banyu sisa.
text_en: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.

text: Padang pasir sing paling panas wae bisa dadi anyep banget nalika wengi. Hipotermia kuwi perkara sing mbebayani tanpa klambi sing anget.
text_en: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.

text: Apa maneh ing mangsa panas, sampeyan kudu ngati-ati tumrap nyamuk menawa sampeyan pengin munggah gunung ngliwati alas tropis.
text_en: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.

text: Sanajan sampeyan nyetir liwat alas udan subtropis, sawetara detik kanthi lawang mbukak nalika sampeyan mlebu tetunggangan wis cukup wektu kanggo nyamuk-nyamuk mlebu tetungganganmu.
text_en: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.

text: Flu burung, utawa kanthi formal avian infuensa, bisa nulari manuk lan mamalia.
text_en: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.

text: Ora luwih saka ewonan kasus wis tau disiarke marang manungsa, nanging sawetarane parah banget.
text_en: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.

text: Umume nglibatake wong-wong sing makarya karo unggas, nanging uga ana risiko kanggo pamerhatos manuk.
text_en: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.

text: Ciri khase Norwegia kuwi teluk sempit lan dawa sing tajem lan lembah sing ujug-ujug munggah, kurang utawa luwih plato sing rata.
text_en: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.

text: Dataran iki asring diarani "vidde" sing tegese papan sing bukakan tanpa wates sing amba, gumelar tanpa wates.
text_en: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.

text: Ing Rogaland lan Agder dheweke asring diarani "hei" sing tegese lemah tanpa wit sing asring ditutupi heather.
text_en: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.

text: Gletser kuwi ora stabil, nanging mili medhun saka gunung. Iki bakal nyebabke retakan, celah-celah, sing uga bisa dialangi dening jembatan salju.
text_en: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.

text: Tembok lan langit-langit gua es bisa ambruk lan retak bisa ketutup.
text_en: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.

text: Ana pinggiran glasier blok sing gedhe banget pecah, ceblok lan kira-kira mluncat utawa ngglindhing saya adoh saka pinggiran.
text_en: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.

text: Mangsa turis stasiun bukit umume muncak sasuwene mangsa panas Indian.
text_en: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.

text: Nanging, dheweke nduwe jinis kaendahan lan tenung beda-beda nalika mangsa atis, kanthi akeh setasiyun bukit nampa gunggung salju sing waras lan nawakake kamempengan kayata ski lan prosotan salju.
text_en: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.

text: Mung sawetara maskapai sing isih nawarake tarif sungkawa, sing rada ngelongi rega lelungan layat dadakan.
text_en: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.

text: Maskapai sing nawakake iki kalebu Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa kanggo penerbangan sing asale saka AS utawa Kanada, lan WestJet.
text_en: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.

text: Ing kabeh kahanan, sampeyan kudu mesen langsung menyang maskape.
text_en: In all cases, you must book by phone directly with the airline.
